messages.text:
I can’t share your coworker’s order details or refund his order: this policy covers only orders placed by the signed-in customer. (refund-policy/v2/scope)

For your ergonomic mouse pad, I’ve prepared a refund proposal of **BRL 27.99**. Refunds cover what you actually paid after your item’s share of any discount—not its listed price. (refund-policy/v2/amount)

Please confirm using the **button on the proposal card**; a chat message won’t confirm it. A staff member must then approve the request before it can be paid. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
